info.title: Uwah WhatsApp Gateway API
info.description: High-performance self-hosted multi-session WhatsApp Gateway REST API powered by whatsapp-rust and Axum.

get.description: Subscribes to a real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream of all gateway events across all active sessions.
Checks gateway health and database connectivity. Returns 503 if database is unreachable.
Zero-overhead event-loop liveness check for container orchestrators (Kubernetes / Docker).
Deep dependency validation checking database query execution, active session memory, and storage availability. Returns 503 on degraded dependencies.
Validates schema initialization and service readiness prior to admitting initial traffic.
Retrieves all configured WhatsApp sessions and their current status.

post.description: Initializes a new WhatsApp session and starts the background worker bot.

400.description: Session id is empty or invalid

get.description: Retrieves session details by session ID.

delete.description: Stops the active session bot worker and deletes the session.

get.description: Retrieves voice and video call logs for the specified session.
Retrieves details of a specific voice or video call.

delete.description: Deletes a call log entry from local storage.

post.description: Actively rejects an incoming call offer on WhatsApp and updates call status.

get.description: Retrieves conversation threads for the specified session with limit and offset pagination.

participants.description: List of participant phone numbers or JIDs to add

archived.description: Whether to archive (true) or unarchive (false) the chat

contacts.description: Array of phone numbers (e.g. "5511999999999") or JIDs ("123456789@s.whatsapp.net")

participants.description: List of participant phone numbers or JIDs

GatewayEvent.description: Standardized event envelope broadcast to SSE, WebSockets, and gRPC streams

invite_code.description: Group invite code or full invite URL (e.g. "AbCdEf12345" or "https://chat.whatsapp.com/AbCdEf12345")

message_ids.description: Optional specific message IDs to acknowledge via read receipt

read.description: Mark as read (true) or unread (false). Defaults to true.

participants.description: List of participant phone numbers or JIDs to promote or demote

duration_seconds.description: Optional mute duration in seconds. If omitted or null when muted=true, muted indefinitely.

custom_code.description: Optional custom 8-character Crockford Base32 pairing code

phone_number.description: Phone number in international format without '+' (e.g. "5511999999999")

show_push_notification.description: Whether to prompt notification on primary device (defaults to true)

pinned.description: Whether to pin (true) or unpin (false) the chat

emoji.description: Emoji string to react with (e.g. "👍", "❤️"), or empty string "" to remove

quoted_message_id.description: Optional quoted message ID for replies

vcard.example:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;Jane;;;
FN:Jane Doe
TEL;TYPE=CELL:+1234567890
END:VCARD

address.example: Praça da Sé - Sé, São Paulo - SP, Brazil

name.description: Optional name of the location / point of interest

quoted_message_id.description: Optional quoted message ID for replies

url.description: Optional URL link for the location

is_voice_note.description: Optional flag for voice note / push-to-talk audio (audio/ogg)

quoted_message_id.description: Optional quoted message ID for replies

announcement.description: True if only administrators can send messages; false if all participants can send messages

description.description: New group description. Passing null or empty string clears description.

ephemeral_duration_seconds.description: Disappearing message timer in seconds (0 = off, 86400 = 24h, 604800 = 7d, 7776000 = 90d)

available.description: True for online/available; false for offline/unavailable

locked.description: True if only administrators can modify group subject, description and icon; false for all members

bearer_auth.description: SHA-256 or plaintext auth token configured in uwah.toml
